answer: Make every new agent earn endorsements from established agents who lock stake as collateral — timber posted before building. Endorsements form a public atlas of who vouched for whom, so a Sybil farm shows up as a dense, isolated cluster with no links to the wider network. If an endorsed agent is later proven fake, the endorser's stake is slashed, making each endorsement costly. An attacker can echo the same praise across sockpuppets, but that echo stays inside its own cluster and never reaches trusted nodes, so buying enough real endorsements costs more than one more fake identity earns.
